title: GenuinePurity® Liposomal Quercetin Review – Immunity & Inflammation Support
abstract:
## What is GenuinePurity® Liposomal Quercetin?  
GenuinePurity® Liposomal Quercetin is a dietary supplement formulated to deliver the antioxidant and anti-inflammatory benefits of quercetin in a more bioavailable form. Quercetin is a flavonoid found naturally in fruits, vegetables, and grains, known for its powerful antioxidant properties. However, quercetin on its own is not easily absorbed by the body, which is where the liposomal delivery system comes into play.  
Liposomal technology encapsulates nutrients like quercetin in phospholipid-based liposomes, which significantly enhances absorption. This allows for better bioavailability, meaning more of the active ingredient reaches your bloodstream and can be utilized by your body.  
**Study Reference**:
A study on liposomal quercetin found that this method of delivery can increase the absorption and bioavailability of quercetin in the body, leading to more significant therapeutic effects. [PubMed study on liposomal quercetin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30345151/)

## GenuinePurity® Liposomal Quercetin Key Ingredients  
**1. Quercetin**:
Quercetin is a flavonoid found in foods like onions, apples, and berries. It is well-known for its antioxidant properties, helping to combat oxidative stress in the body. This makes it effective in reducing inflammation and supporting immune function.
– **Health Benefits**: Quercetin is a potent antioxidant that may help with seasonal allergies, heart health, and inflammation.  
**2. Liposomal Delivery System**:
Liposomal technology encapsulates quercetin in tiny phospholipid vesicles, improving its absorption and bioavailability. This allows the body to utilize a higher percentage of the active ingredient, leading to more effective results.  
**3. Vitamin C**:
Many liposomal quercetin supplements, including this one, are paired with vitamin C, another powerful antioxidant that supports the immune system. Vitamin C works synergistically with quercetin to improve absorption and enhance its overall effectiveness.
